title: CUBEBENCH: DIAGNOSING INTERACTIVE, LONG-HORIZON SPATIAL REASONING UNDER PARTIAL OBSERVATIONS
reasoning: The paper introduces "CubeBench," a benchmark focused on evaluating the spatial reasoning, long-horizon planning, and active exploration capabilities of Large Language Models using a Rubik's Cube simulation. The scope is purely technical and cognitive, with no component related to assessing religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
